name: hyperclick
author: lumine-code
description: Follow the symbol under the pointer to its definition with a click.
backgroundTips: {% if keys['hyperclick:confirm-cursor'] %}You can follow the symbol under the cursor to its definition with {{ 'hyperclick:confirm-cursor' | keystroke }}{% else %}You can hold Alt and click a symbol to jump to its definition.{% endif %}

modifier.title: Modifier
modifier.description: The key held down to turn symbols into links. Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) is also the editor's add-a-cursor modifier, so choosing it trades one for the other.

hoverDelay.title: Hover Delay
hoverDelay.description: How long the pointer must rest on a symbol, in milliseconds, before its providers are asked about it. Higher values ask less often while the pointer is travelling.

hyperclick.provider.description: Turns a word in the editor into something clickable.
